invariants.rationale: writeClient must be non-null to invoke methods on it.
instantTime must be non-null as it is used to identify the commit instant.
preppedRecordInputs must be non-null since it is passed for bulk insert.
Result of bulkInsertPreppedRecords should be non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
If there are prepped records, write status list should not be empty and vice versa.
